test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Rohit said, “The board game is mine.”

options.text: Rohit said that the board game was his.
Rohit said that the board game was me.
Rohit said that he was the board game.
Rohit said that the board game were hers.

solution:
The correct option is: **Rohit said that the board game was his**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When converting direct speech to reported speech, the tense typically shifts back.
 
• Hence **"is" **(Present tense) becomes** "was" **(Past tense) in reported speech.
 
• **Pronouns** also change according to the speaker and context. **"Mine"** changes to** "his"** when reporting Rohit's speech.
 
• The structure "Rohit said that..." is used to introduce the reported speech, maintaining the meaning of the original statement while adhering to grammatical norms for reported speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is- ***Rohit said that the board game was his*.**
